Overview

Geelong is a city in Victoria with a population of 282,809. Victoria’s second city with a revitalized waterfront, the Great Ocean Road gateway, and AFL heartland. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
